posts.author: Eliaquim
posts.body:
Hi there!
First of all: If you are new with RPG Maker, you shouldn't be trying use plugins at all. Learn the engine first.
Now about your problem, you need to specify a little bit more. Just saying something like "I’ve checked LITTERALLY everything" it's not helpful, you need to show what you did.
Link the plugin you are using and show screenshots of your events/plugin commands/plugin parameters. So other people that know how to use this plugin can help you out with this.
Another alternative would be try to find the plugin author and post on the plugin thread the problem you are having with it.
Unfortunatelly, I never used this plugin. Can't help you with that. But good luck on your project!

posts.author: Deleted member 281703
posts.body:
Hello, and welcome ^^
If you're starting out with sprite animations, create one which has this format:
12 cells, where each cell is 48x48 (the entire image size should be 144x192.
Be sure to save it in img/characters/ in your game project, then add a dollar sign ($) in front the name. Like $MyCharacter.png
Then you should be able to use a sprite for your character!

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
Is your issue that the sprites used by the custom plugin aren't showing at all? If so, I notice in your screenshots that you have file extensions hidden. Is it possible that your custom sprites are, say BMP files instead of PNG files? As far as I know, RPGMaker only supports PNG images, so if you put a BMP image in, it won't see it at all.
Just a thought, in case it was something you hadn't thought to check.
